podcast.body: Shaun Cassidy's cover of this song, released in 1977 on his debut album, went to number one. It was critically panned by Scott Kane of the *Atlanta Constitution* as an "excruciating piece of music." "Sean Cassidy his cover of The Do Run Run from 1977 it was on his debut album it went to number one."

podcast.body: Shaun Cassidy, the half-brother of David Cassidy, propelled his cover of The Crystals' 1963 hit "Da Doo Ron Ron" to number one in 1977. This success exemplified how covers were an effective method for 70s teen idols to achieve chart prominence. "Sean Cassidy, who took his cover of the crystals 1963 hit, Da Do Run Run, to number one in 1977."
